subject: NovaCart: Queue starvation in dedicated pool — mitigation, credits, and follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novacart.com>, Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv@novacart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-11T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: NovaCart: Queue starvation in dedicated pool — mitigation, credits, and follow-up

Hi Elena / Rajiv,

I wanted to reach out immediately with what we know and the steps we're taking. Early this morning (window 02:04–02:33 UTC) NovaCart traffic routed to your Redwood dedicated GPU pool experienced a sustained queue-starvation condition. The symptom set we observed: growing token queue, elevated p99/p999 latency for streaming responses, and an increase in 503 errors for short-lived inference jobs. Impact appears focused to your nightly batch load and a handful of peak web inference requests during the same window.

What we did immediately:
- Routed a subset of traffic to warm spare nodes to reduce end-user latency and prevent further request timeouts.
- Temporarily increased allowed concurrent sessions for your pool to reduce queuing for backfilled requests.
- Rolled back a recent autoscaler tuning change that correlated with the start of the window.

Current status: the warm-spare routing and rollback removed the immediate pressure; queue depth returned to normal by ~02:38 UTC. We still see two residual error spikes tied to KV cache warmup on a small subset of nodes — ops is continuing the investigation.

Attachments: provisional metrics export (novacart-metrics-20281011.csv) and an initial draft of the RCA (provisional-rca-draft-20281011.pdf).

Committed next steps and timeline:
- Short-term mitigations (done): warm-spare routing, autoscaler rollback.
- Ops hotfix: identified candidate patch to autoscaler edge-case (KV cache + warmup lock) — target deploy in 48h with canary in one region.
- Postmortem: full RCA and customer-facing postmortem within 72 hours.
- Customer credit: provisional credit proposal (see attached) — final number after postmortem.

I know this disrupted your peak jobs — we are prioritizing the fix and will share a live link to an interim console view for your team in the next hour. Would you be available for a 30-minute sync today to walk through the mitigations and confirm any immediate configuration changes on your side?

Apologies for the disruption — we'll make this right.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments:
- novacart-metrics-20281011.csv (CSV, 78KB)
- provisional-rca-draft-20281011.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

Date: 2028-10-11T08:49:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NovaCart incident — quick internal coordination

Team — baking a short customer update for NovaCart and prepping the credit proposal. Key facts:
- Impact window: 02:04–02:33 UTC (queue starvation + short 503 spikes).
- Root cause (prelim): autoscaler edge-case combined with KV cache warmup lock on a small subset of nodes during high batch churn.
- Mitigation applied: routing to warm spares, autoscaler rollback.

Proposals:
1) Customer-facing credit: provisional 5% of October usage bill as immediate gesture + escalation path to bump to 10% if final RCA shows sustained service-level breach.
2) Ops runbook: schedule a canary deploy of the autoscaler patch in 48h and a forced KV cache priming job for NovaCart to avoid cold starts during nightly batches.
3) Offer a 1:1 technical deep-dive with our infra/serving engineers this week.

Ben — are you okay with 5% provisional? Mina — ops ETA on the canary and patch? Connor — can you own the console link and the log export for Elena's team?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaCart incident — quick internal coordination

Marissa — 5% provisional credit is fine as a gesture, but push for a commitment to finalize after RCA. If root cause confirms we missed an SLA window, we should be prepared to move to the 10% bracket. Also, include a free month of "priority warm pool" for November as a goodwill add-on — they should be able to opt-in.

Mina — please confirm patch ETA; if it's >48h we need to provide a temporary SRE rota to monitor the warm spares overnight.

Ben

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaCart incident — quick internal coordination

Confirming ops notes: identified deterministic autoscaler code path where concurrent cache priming + job churn can stall the allocation loop. I have a candidate fix that adds a backoff + lock timeout; I expect to have a canary-ready build in ~36 hours (target 2028-10-12T22:00:00Z) and a controlled rollout thereafter. Will run the canary in us-west-2 against low-traffic test tenants first.

I'll also prepare a short runbook for NovaCart with steps to reduce cold-start risk (priming job and a congestion-aware concurrency knob). Connor — ping me when you have the console link so I can attach the logs to the runbook.

— Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novacart.com>, Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv@novacart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: NovaCart: Queue starvation in dedicated pool — mitigation, credits, and follow-up

Elena — thanks for confirming availability. 11:30 PT works and I just sent a calendar invite for 30 minutes (invite: HS-54321).

Quick answers to your questions:
1) Temporary routing rule: pool id redwood-dedicated-66 (we routed ~18% of traffic to warm-spare pool id redwood-warm-4); IPs and manifest are attached in the Drive link included below.
2) Concurrency changes: we recommend waiting for the runbook — the short-term rollbacks we performed should be sufficient. That said, if you want an immediate conservative knob, set batch_concurrency_max to 16 for the nightly batch jobs until the canary completes; Mina can provide the exact command.

Attached: credit proposal (credit-proposal-2up-20281011.xlsx) and a provisional RCA draft (provisional-rca-draft-20281011.pdf).

We’ll cover the canary timeline and the exact credit calculation in the 11:30 PT sync.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: NovaCart incident — internal closeout notes

Quick record for the ticket:
- Customer: NovaCart (DEAL-7842) — affected window 02:04–02:33 UTC on 2028-10-11 (queue starvation).
- Immediate mitigations: warm-spare routing, autoscaler rollback (completed).
- Root cause (final, provisional): autoscaler allocation loop can stall when concurrent KV cache priming overlaps heavy batch churn — candidate fix implemented with backoff + lock timeout.
- Canary timeline: canary deployed 2028-10-12T22:00:00Z in us-west-2; metrics appear stable in the first 6h.
- Customer commitments: provisional 5% credit + optional free month of priority warm pool (Ben). Final credit to be confirmed post-RCA.
- Next items: finalize customer-facing RCA (due 2028-10-14T08:00:00-07:00), finalize credit paperwork and notify billing.

Thanks for the fast action. I’ll file the postmortem and close the ticket after we share the customer-facing RCA and the finalized credit.

Marissa
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
